subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and which runtime/session/status/channel surfaces should consume it?
rationale: The remaining work changes stable runtime/session semantics, provider-cost precedence, units, persistence, and channel/plugin consumption, so automation should not choose the public contract alone.

options.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
options.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback to existing local estimates where exact billing is unavailable.

options.title: Keep exact cost outside core
options.body: Leave core on local estimates and route exact OpenRouter accounting to plugin or external ledger surfaces until a broader billing contract exists.

options.title: Fold into broader usage ledger
options.body: Defer this issue until the native per-call usage ledger and agent-facing usage API define the shared accounting contract.

recommendation.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
recommendation.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback to existing local estimates where exact billing is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current source history and product-review signal across OpenRouter cost reconciliation and the runtime/session usage surfaces.
